messages:
Maria S: Heads-up — security wants to deprecate S3-managed default SSE-S3 for DB snapshot uploads next quarter. We need owners + a migration plan. TL;DR: move to customer-managed CMK (SSE-KMS).

Kevin T: Ack. Which snapshots are in-scope? prod masters, replicas, long-term archives? Any exemptions?

Maria S: All prod clusters + long-term archives. Short-term staging can be exempt for 30 days if team files an exemption. Exemption form: https://redwood.internal/docs/enc-migration

Samir R: How do restores behave if someone forgets to create or renew grants? Concerned about KMS grant TTLs and cross-account restores.

Irene L: We should require ephemeral grants via the KMS Grant API with TTL <= 12h and mandate recording the grant id in the restore ticket/audit entry. enc-ops-bot can tag grants.

enc-ops-bot: [automation] Created ticket ENC-412 for rollout gating. Runbook stub: /runbooks/enc-migration.md

Maria S: Example grant creation so teams have a pattern:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/rw-prod-cmk \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-restore \
  --operations Decrypt,Encrypt \
  --constraints EncryptionContextEquals={"snapshot":"true"} \
  --name "ephemeral-restore-$(date +%s)"
```
Make sure `--retiring-principal` is set for automation to revoke.

Kevin T: We also need an RBAC change: backup service account should only have `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket`, and kms:Decrypt limited to that CMK + encryption context. I'll sketch a policy.

Samir R: Add a pre-restore check in the UI/CLI: verify KMS grant exists + log presence of grant ID and caller in auditchain. If grant missing, block restore and page oncall.

Irene L: +1. Detection rule for log-shipper: if KMS returns AccessDenied during decrypt -> create PagerDuty alert with tag `enc.restore.accessdenied`.

Maria S: What about already archived snapshots uploaded with SSE-S3? Plan: re-encrypt by copying objects server-side with SSE-KMS (S3 CopyObject). We need to estimate time/cost for ~30TB. Ops to confirm window.

Kevin T: For re-encrypt, the copier role needs kms:Encrypt + kms:ReEncrypt? Practically we do `CopyObject` with header `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` and `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id`. Make sure the copier has a grant on the new CMK.

Samir R: Also, check DB-native snapshot formats for embedded metadata or cleartext keys in headers — we should scan manifests for any plaintext credential fields.

Irene L: I'll schedule a metadata scan job to grep common headers/metadata (`x-amz-meta-`, `cleartext`, `unencrypted`) and flag buckets. Adding to enc-ops backlog.

Maria S: Policy addition: snapshot manifest must include `kms_key_id` and `encryption_version`. If missing at ingestion, object should be quarantined and owner paged.

Kevin T: Can we add an automated fallback for apps: if decrypt fails, route reads to read-only cached export to reduce user-facing downtime? Might be tricky and could mask issues.

Samir R: That hides failures — prefer failing loudly, auto-ticketing, and a documented restore playbook.

Irene L: For vuln triage: if an uploader role is leaked we rotate CMK grants and rotate uploader credentials immediately, run a retroactive access audit to see what was touched. Also rotate snapshot manifest signing keys.

Maria S: Action items (EOW): 1) Draft RBAC patch for backup role (Kevin). 2) Build grant TTL automation + detection rules (Irene). 3) Re-encrypt plan + cost estimate for archived snaps (Samir). 4) Update restore playbook with pre-restore grant check (Maria).

Kevin T: I'll open the RBAC PR by EOD tomorrow and ping @Maria S for review.

Samir R: I'll prototype the re-encrypt job and post cost/ETA in #eng-sre before EOW.

enc-ops-bot: [assigned] ENC-412 -> Kevin T, Samir R, Irene L, Maria S

Maria S: Thanks — if anyone finds old unencrypted uploads, @here please paste bucket + path. :eyes:
